$comment: The Mission of St. Gamaliel's Trisagion, sent by Erez 2026-08-06. Their form addresses God in the second person — 'You are holy — God' — where the app's own Hebrew declares 'Holy is God', and it is headed by the Aramaic word the Syriac churches sing it under, קדישת (Qadishat). The ✠▼▲ marks stand exactly where they were sent: ✠ is the cross signed at the opening, as in the Mission's other Trinitarian formulae. trisagionShortAcclamation is composed from their own third and fourth lines, which is what the short form is in every tradition — the one line here not sent verbatim, and the one to confirm with Erez. 2026-08-10, from Erez: the threefold mercy (שילוש הרחמים, his own name for it — now its heading, where the Vicariate's יֵשׁוּעַ שְׁמָעֵנוּ incipit used to leak through) reads the Name, and in this rite the Name is written with Adonai's vowels — יְהֹוָה — unlike everywhere else in the app, where it stays bare.
